sources.title: NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF) 1.0
sources.org: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.notes: Voluntary framework for managing AI risk across the AI lifecycle (Govern, Map, Measure, Manage).

sources.title: NIST AI RMF Generative AI Profile
sources.org: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.notes: Profile applying the AI RMF to generative AI risks and mitigations.

sources.title: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
sources.notes: Top 10 security risks in LLM applications, updated annually/major release.

sources.title: OWASP Agentic AI - Threats and Mitigations
sources.notes: Threat model and mitigations for agentic AI systems, published June 2025.

sources.title: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic AI
sources.notes: Top 10 risks specific to agentic AI (agents, tools, memory, delegation).

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 - Artificial Intelligence Act
sources.notes: First comprehensive AI law; risk-based framework with prohibitions, high-risk requirements, GPAI obligations, and transparency.

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 - Digital Omnibus on AI (amending the AI Act)
sources.notes: First substantive amendment to the AI Act (in force 2026-07-27). Postpones high-risk application to 2 Dec 2027 / 2 Aug 2028, adds Article 5 prohibitions on AI-generated CSAM and non-consensual intimate imagery, and sets transparency/watermarking deadlines.

sources.title: OWASP GenAI Security Project - Top 10 for LLM Applications 2026
sources.notes: 2026 edition of the LLM Top 10. Excessive Agency rose to LLM03; System Prompt Leakage became Hidden Context Exposure (LLM08); adds Unbounded Consumption, Misinformation, Vector/Embedding Weaknesses. Maps to MITRE ATLAS, CWE, NIST AI 600-1, and OWASP Agentic Top 10.

sources.title: OWASP GenAI Security Project - Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026
sources.notes: 2026 edition of the Agentic Top 10 (ASI01-ASI10): Agent Goal Hijack, Tool Misuse, Identity & Privilege Abuse, Agentic Supply Chain, Unexpected RCE, Memory & Context Poisoning, Insecure Agent-to-Agent Communication, Cascading Failures, Human-Agent Trust Exploitation, Rogue Agents.

sources.title: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 Information technology - Artificial intelligence - Management system
sources.notes: First certifiable AI management system (AIMS) standard.

sources.title: ISO/IEC 23894:2023 AI - Guidance on risk management
sources.notes: AI-specific risk management guidance aligned with ISO 31000.

sources.title: MITRE ATLAS (Adversarial Threat Landscape for Artificial-Intelligence Systems)
sources.notes: Knowledge base of adversary tactics and techniques for AI/ML systems.

sources.title: ENISA - AI Threat Landscape
sources.notes: EU agency analysis mapping the AI threat landscape and attack taxonomy.

sources.title: CSA - AI Security Initiative & LLM & Generative AI Application Security
sources.notes: Security controls for LLM and generative AI applications.

sources.title: General Data Protection Regulation (EU) 2016/679
sources.notes: EU data protection law applicable to AI systems processing personal data.

sources.title: CISA - Roadmap for AI
sources.org: CISA (US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency)
sources.notes: US agency roadmap for AI-related security priorities.

sources.title: OWASP Top 10 Web Application Security Risks (2021)
sources.notes: Foundational web application security risks referenced across AI systems.

sources.title: IBM security incident advisory - Langflow critical vulnerabilities
sources.notes: CVE-2026-93680, CVE-2026-110186, CVE-2026-110193, CVE-2026-110192; fixed in Langflow 1.13.0 (2026-10-22). Includes unauthenticated RCE via MCP tool enumeration.

sources.title: JFrog - Prefab UI generative sandbox sandbox escape (CVE-2026-120338)
sources.notes: CVSS 10.0; model-written Python ran with unrestricted host read/write/network permissions; fixed in prefab-ui 0.21.0.

sources.title: CVE-2026-88968 - Claude Code Edit-tool TOCTOU workspace escape
sources.notes: CVSS 4.0 7.7; link-following/TOCTOU (CWE-59, CWE-367) let attacker-controlled code escape the workspace and overwrite user files; fixed in Claude Code 2.1.251.

sources.title: MCPhantom - AI coding agents installing deprecated MCP servers with unpatched RCE
sources.notes: AI coding agents select deprecated MCP servers out of training data and install them; archived servers carry high-severity flaws including a prompt-injection RCE with no fix.
